purpose: Define a reproducible, primary-source GitHub candidate-discovery procedure before any population record, task, treatment output, preview, approval, or model call exists.

api_contract.authentication: A dedicated read-only GitHub App or fine-grained token; credentials are never serialized into receipts.

temporal_contract.primary_rule: The selected Skill package, every public basis fact, and the repository commit used for a primary maintenance task must exist no later than the pre-treatment cutoff.
temporal_contract.post_treatment_rule: Current or post-treatment packages may enter only a separately identified deployment-sensitivity frame and may not contribute to the primary pre-treatment estimate.

target_frame.primary_population: Public, non-archived, non-fork GitHub repositories discoverable by the frozen union of repository queries, with an exact-case SKILL.md package and source-supported maintenance facts at or before the pre-treatment cutoff.
target_frame.claim_boundary: The frame supports inference only to the frozen query-discoverable population after documented eligibility and lineage deduplication; it is not a census of every Skill ever hosted on GitHub.
target_frame.global_coverage_audit: Use GitHub's creation-ordered GET /repositories?since= stream for a separately seeded probability audit of repositories omitted by the query union. The audit estimates discovery coverage but does not silently add hand-picked records.
not_claimed: Completeness for repositories that GitHub did not index or return at the cutoff
Completeness for Skills on non-default branches
Completeness for files or repositories outside GitHub code-search indexing limits
Generalization to private repositories or non-GitHub Skill packages

date_sharding.algorithm: Bisect an over-limit inclusive UTC interval at whole-second precision into [start, midpoint] and [midpoint + 1 second, end] until every leaf reports at most 900 results.
date_sharding.pagination: Request every page in each leaf until the response Link header has no rel=next.

repository_discovery.completeness_gate: Every leaf must have incomplete_results=false, total_count <= 900, a continuous page ledger, and a deduplicated returned count equal to its declared total_count before the repository-query union is frozen.

code_candidate_discovery.role: Candidate expansion and feasibility diagnostics only; code-search results are never used as the population denominator or as a stratum classifier.

queries.query: path:/(^|\/)(?-i)SKILL\.md$/ /^(?-i)name:[\t ]+/ NOT /^(?-i)compatibility:/ NOT is:fork NOT is:archived

code_candidate_discovery.completeness_caveat: GitHub code search is dynamic and index-bounded, searches only indexed default-branch files, and a regex can match examples in a Skill body rather than YAML frontmatter. Every hit must be resolved to an immutable blob and parsed by the pinned YAML fact extractor.
prohibited_uses: Treating a displayed approximate file count as an eligible repository count
Classifying YAML type or semantic validity from regex text
Selecting a task directly from result order
Replacing an excluded selected record with an investigator-chosen hit

repository_verification.commit_rule: Resolve the latest commit on the repository's then-default branch whose committed timestamp is at or before the cohort cutoff; bind commit, tree, branch name, and lookup response digests.
repository_verification.skill_rule: Enumerate the immutable recursive tree, accept only exact-case files named SKILL.md, and select at most one eligible package per repository by the externally seeded ordering declared in the V2 protocol.
required_reads: license metadata and exact license blob
public issue, pull request, commit, or Skill-blob basis records
fork parent, source repository, and template-repository metadata
repository_verification.exclusion_ledger: Record every discovered repository and package with a terminal included or excluded decision, reason code, reviewer state, and immutable source identities.

readiness.next_gate: Implement reviewed trusted preparation, execute it with read-only GitHub credentials, and freeze complete query, eligibility, lineage, and coverage-audit receipts under a new population identity.
